description.describe_ch: 因應企業營運多以資訊系統運作，本課程將讓學生了解電腦稽核理論與實務，並於課堂上實作分析不同類型的個案，讓研究生同時具備電腦稽核應用實務技術以及理論知識。
description.describe_eh: Many companies operation mostly based on information systems, this course will enable students to understand the theory and practice of computer auditing, and implement analysis of different types of cases in the classroom, so that graduate students can also have practical analysis skills and theoretical knowledge of computer auditing applications.

readings.tpc_book: 電腦稽核-理論與實務應用(第2版)
readings.tpc_book_en:
Information Technology Auditing 4/e [Hall] 9781133949886
  • Today’s Most Common Computer-Aided Audit Tools and Techniques (CAATTS) are highlighted. The book introduces popular computer-aided audit tools and techniques using clearly written presentations and graphical illustrations that form an easy-to-understand model for learning.
  • Book Focuses on Computer Control Issues and Their Impact on Operational Efficiency. The auditor’s attest responsibility, computer control issues, and operational efficiency are all central themes in this edition. Numerous cases and problems reinforce the learning objectives related to these topics.
  • The Risk Analysis Approach In This Book Helps You Emphasize This Approach In Your Course. This text provides the tools to teach a risk-based approach to the identification of key threats. Students learn to develop appropriate audit tests and procedures in the following areas: Operating Systems (mainframes and PCs), Data Management, Systems Development, Electronic Commerce (including networks, EDI and Internet risks), Organizational Structure, Computer Center, and Computer Applications (Revenue and Expenditure cycle).

gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol:
課堂禮儀
多元化和包容性
所有課程活動都將在同學之間的友好參與和互動氛圍中進行，彼此間尊重和欣賞每位同學的個人經歷、背景和觀點，如國內外各學制、多元入學及學習文化、性別等。希望您始終在本課程中應用最高的學術標準，並以有尊嚴和尊重的態度對待同學。
課堂行為
課堂上的行為始終應要及時、要專業、要做好準備、要有禮貌。同學、教師或其他講師間，應保有彼此尊嚴和相互尊重，才能進行有效的學習。為了確保有利於學習環境，冀望每個人都能做到以下幾點，彼此遵守課堂行為規則，習慣禮貌的文化。
學生應準時出席上課。如果您的上課時間，無法按時到課，請不要選課。 除非您生病或有緊急情況，否則應在上課前，要準時到達教室，並坐在位子上。如果您有某種原因必須提早下課，請提前告知我。
所有學生在課堂上都應尊重每個人，並且在任何時候都應以合理、負責和禮貌的態度行事。
上課時請勿講話、閱讀、睡覺或做其他非本課程相關作業，除分組進行討論外，否則應盡量減少邊際對話。如果您正坐在一個可能在上課時和您聊天的人旁邊，請移到另一個座位，以免您屈服於誘惑。
當同學簡報或提問時，您應該專心地聆聽。當您簡報時，您應該面對自己的小組或全班同學大聲說話，讓同學能聽清楚。
允許使用筆記型電腦或平板等載具，進行課堂記筆記，否則應將其收起。
要確保在上課時，關閉手機、PDA等移動設備，並收起及保持靜音。
不得戴耳機上課。
穿著整潔，不要暴露。
冀望以最高標準、互相尊重的專業對話模式，以多樣化和包容性，講述課程規則內容。
教師得以引導學生方式，學習過程中學生要做的事，應有的責任。
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol_en: This course emphasizes etiquette in both physical classrooms and online spaces. In physical classrooms, students are expected to arrive on time, pay attention during lectures, and refrain from using mobile phones. In online virtual environments, students are required to keep their cameras on, avoid engaging in unrelated activities, and respond promptly. Violations of these rules will impact grades or lead to other penalties. It is hoped that everyone will work together to maintain a conducive learning environment.
gradeRuleDescribe.course_rem: 親愛的學生們，請記得上課時保持專注，並避免使用手機或其他干擾因素。我們有提供額外的學習資源，如教科書和線上教材，以協助你們更深入地理解課程內容。希望大家能充分利用這些資源，共同創造一個更有效的學習環境。
gradeRuleDescribe.course_rem_en: Dear students, please stay focused during class and avoid using mobile phones or engaging with other distractions. We have provided additional learning resources, such as textbooks and online materials, to help you better understand the course content. We hope you will fully utilize these resources to create a more effective learning environment.
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno: 期望學生在學習評量、班上互動和課程結束後能展示學術誠信，包括不抄襲、不作弊並遵守學校和課程的相關規範。違反學術誠信的學生將面臨學校和課程規定的相應處分，可能包括但不限於失去評分資格、學科警告或更嚴重的學校紀律處分。希望學生能遵守學術誠信，以確保教學品質和個人成長。
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno_en: Students are expected to demonstrate academic integrity in assessments and classroom interactions after completing courses that include refraining from plagiarism and cheating, and adhering to the relevant norms and regulations of the school and courses. Students found violating academic integrity will face appropriate sanctions as stipulated by the school and course policies, which may include, but are not limited to, loss of grading privileges, academic warnings, or more severe disciplinary actions by the school. Students are encouraged to uphold academic integrity to ensure quality education and personal development.

policy.ais_meno: 期望學生在學習評量、班上互動和課程結束後能展示學術誠信，包括不抄襲、不作弊並遵守學校和課程的相關規範。違反學術誠信的學生將面臨學校和課程規定的相應處分，可能包括但不限於失去評分資格、學科警告或更嚴重的學校紀律處分。希望學生能遵守學術誠信，以確保教學品質和個人成長。
policy.ais_meno_en: Students are expected to demonstrate academic integrity in assessments and classroom interactions after completing courses that include refraining from plagiarism and cheating, and adhering to the relevant norms and regulations of the school and courses. Students found violating academic integrity will face appropriate sanctions as stipulated by the school and course policies, which may include, but are not limited to, loss of grading privileges, academic warnings, or more severe disciplinary actions by the school. Students are encouraged to uphold academic integrity to ensure quality education and personal development.
